content.title: Frustrated Mariners fans left scrambling to find out how to watch the game | The Seattle Times

(Jennifer Buchanan / The Seattle Times) Skip Ad By Ryan Divish Seattle Times staff reporter Opening day for perhaps the most anticipated season in Mariners history should’ve been a celebration for fans anxious to watch a team with World Series aspirations start a 162-game journey.Instead, for many fans, it was a day of frustration, spent checking the channel guides on their televisions and constantly updating a website that was supposed to provide clarity to a simple question — what channel is the Mariners’ game on?
